name: Ufly
ability: Neon Swarm (its own: from level 20, while above a quarter of its HP, it calls its swarm and fights in its Swarm Form)
look: a plump little purple bug with a lime-green back, two big translucent wings standing up like ears, great teal compound eyes and glowing teal spots
entry: On moonless nights strange lights hover over the fields and vanish: a single Ufly's glow is faint, but when it calls, its swarm gathers into a great humming saucer of neon light.
how: Wild: common at night in plains, grasslands, swamps and forests, and everywhere on new-moon nights.
Swarm Form: in battle, from level 20, while its HP is above a quarter, its ability Neon Swarm calls its swarm and it becomes a ~10-block flying saucer made of thousands of Uflys (like Wishiwashi).
